description: Horus, future Lord of the Horizons, was born to Aesys and Osiris, first among the ancient pantheon of the land of Urzyma. Conceived shortly before the Lord of Life had left to investigate an unknown disruption in the fabric of reality, Horus never truly knew his father—even before Osiris had been reduced to a twisted shell of his former self by the God-King.
summon:
Who goes there?
Be you man, beast, or ill-made god, I am not afraid.
For I am Harakhte, Prince of the Horizons!
fusion:
Soar free!
The winds favor our wings!
evolution:
Great Mother and Father!
Thy legacy I yearn still to carry on...
